description: Pradeshiya Sabha Arachchikattuwa - Roads and Thoroughfares owned by the Pradeshiya Sabha Arachchikattuwa
categorisation: This gazette notification deals specifically with land and property matters - the declaration of roads and thoroughfares as owned by the Pradeshiya Sabha Arachchikattuwa local government authority. It includes detailed schedules with land coordinates, road measurements, and legal determinations of property ownership under the Pradeshiya Sabha Act. While it mentions government officials and references previous gazette notifications, the core content is about land/property ownership determination and registration, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
